Whenever a resume amnesty is newer than the cycle start, the parenthetical gloss and the definition it glosses give different round numbers. — The pinned fact states incompatible review-round boundaries, plausibly causing incorrect step_up behavior that the named tests miss, while correction requires only a local boundary re-pin and one regression test.

- `claude-S4-CLAUDE-CORRUPT-DEFAULT-DOC-BLOCKS-START` (raised claude, cleared codex): The note's acceptance and its named test require a corrupt stored `default` DOCUMENT to let every dispatch proceed on the default document with `staffing_fallback` on the marker, but a homed Driver fails at startup before any dispatch: `Driver` startup calls `staffing.ensure_documents` (orchestrator/driver.py:766-778), which at orchestrator/staffing.py:1197-1198 loads a `default` document that exists, propagates `StaffingError`, and the driver turns it into `fail_run("staffing catalogue unavailable")` plus a RuntimeError. The resolver-level fallback (`_document_for`, staffing.py:1736-1739) is real, but the run never reaches it. — The note pins incorrect behavior and a misleading test contract because startup prevents the resolver fallback, but the first correctly scoped test or step exposes it and correction is a small local startup-gate change.

A review dispatch on a no-family run therefore stops with `distinct_families_unsatisfiable`, not the `staffing_unavailable` the note's acceptance names. — The pinned pre-dispatch projection can silently select the wrong failure token when no family is available, but the strict minimal test exposes it immediately and correction is one local precedence guard.
- `claude-S4-CLAUDE-STATE-SIDE-FAMILY-EVIDENCE` (raised claude, cleared codex): The Reuse Posture and the Enforceability Gate both assert that 'the seal predicate's existing families parameter and the summary's existing review-projection parameter ... already accept a computed value from the driver, so neither state nor the summary learns about the router', citing orchestrator/state.py:1112-1116. Those lines are `can_open_seal(state, unit)`, which takes no families parameter and reads `state["config"]["families_order"]` itself (the parameterised `seal_predicate_reviews` begins at 1119); and `st.summary` derives the displayed reviewing family from `state["config"]["families_order"][unit["family_index"]]` at state.py:2676-2680, while the existing projection parameter carries only a model string (driver.resolve_current_review_model returns a model). The evidence cited does not support the answer for either half. — The note states wrong behavior at two correctness seams and could preserve families_order for sealing and status, but focused seat-cycle and projection tests should expose it and correction is bounded parameter plumbing within this unit.
- `claude-S4-CLAUDE-HOOK-NOT-ONLY-ENTRY` (raised claude, cleared codex): The Enforceability Gate row for 'Every driver call takes its staffing from the router' names the per-dispatch resolver hook (orchestrator/runners.py:2941-2962) as 'the only place a family, model and effort enter a call'. - `claude-S4-CLAUDE-R3-001` (raised claude, cleared codex): The note re-keys four `orchestrator/state.py` review-rotation predicates but its focused command and its "No unrelated behaviour moved" row never name `orchestrator/tests/test_state.py`, the only suite that pins three of them, so the slice can be accepted green while review rotation is broken or silently signature-changed. — Omitting test_state can let focused-only verification miss direct review-rotation regressions despite the new cycle checks, but the unchanged full discovery gate will expose them and correction remains bounded to this unit's rotation predicates and tests.

- `claude-S5-RESOLVE-ENVELOPE-FALLBACK-UNDECIDED` (raised claude, cleared codex): The successful-resolve envelope is pinned two incompatible ways, so whether an HTTP caller is ever told it was staffed from the default-document fallback is left undecided — and on the closed-envelope reading the API is the one staffing consumer where the mandatory fallback is invisible. — The note both closes the 200 envelope to a three-key staffing answer and requires comparison with a resolver result that separately carries the fallback note, so its tests permit silent implementation of the wrong observable API contract, while correction is only a local envelope-and-test re-pin.
